trigger: Replace the single-entry id_uop holding register with a real ready-select issue queue and optimize IPC x Fmax
notes: Added a three-entry fixed-slot oldest-ready issue queue with memory ordering and commit-head branch issue. Added registered load-result bypass and independent memory-address readiness to preserve IPC while reducing DCache timing fanout. RV32IM 52/52 passed; srcSmoke and srcWithMext short windows passed; srcWithMext 20M reached IPC 0.795558. Post-route WNS is -0.779584 ns at a 5.0 ns constraint. Mirrored DCache probes were removed after showing an ideal dual-load ceiling of about +0.0226 IPC with insufficient timing margin.
